recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，一個大型淋巴聚集幾乎全部呈強陽性棕色（膜性），周圍造血細胞陰性，形態與分布符合 B 細胞標記（多為 CD20）標出以 B 細胞為主的濾泡/生發中心。
features: Large lymphoid aggregate with dense, strong brown membranous staining of the majority of cells
Staining is sharply confined to the aggregate; surrounding hematopoietic cells are negative
Few scattered positive cells in the interstitium
Small central vessel within the positive aggregate
Adjacent bone trabecula (right) shows no paratrabecular positive infiltrate
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows a large intertrabecular lymphoid aggregate in which most cells are strongly positive, with only rare scattered positive cells in the surrounding interstitium. The distribution is compatible with a B-cell marker (such as CD20) highlighting a B-cell follicle; the specific antibody is not stated. The aggregate is well circumscribed and not paratrabecular. Findings support a B-cell-rich lymphoid follicle; light-chain, BCL2 and CD10 studies are needed to exclude a B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: FL follicles are paratrabecular and co-express BCL2 with CD10/BCL6 in follicle center cells, whereas reactive germinal centers are BCL2-negative.
MZL shows light-chain-restricted B cells, often with intrasinusoidal distribution, which a single CD20 stain cannot distinguish from reactive B cells.
A T-cell-predominant or mast cell lesion would be largely negative for a B-cell marker, unlike this diffusely positive aggregate.
